[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Dixton''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Dixton was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]].<ref name="Godking" /> Officially, Dixton held the rank of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], but preferred the more prestigious title of "Governor-General."<ref name="Godking-CC">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Classic Campaigns}}</ref> He had a mistress, [[Marska]], who was secretly a loyal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] tasked with keeping Dixton in line. Dixton was traveling aboard the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']] with a light [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] escort when they were attacked by [[The Irregulars|Irregular]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. To escape, the ship made an emergency jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] which deposited the ship several [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from its destination above [[Abonshee]]. Damaged in the escape, with life-support failing and its [[grav motor]] compromised, the shuttle ejected a [[distress buoy]] and made an emergency landing on Abonshee, just outside of the [[Godking's castle]]. Dixton was subsequently captured by [[Green squad]] of the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], who were on-planet at the time negotiating with the [[Godking]], [[Trisstan]].<ref name="Godking" />

==Personality and traits==
Dixton was an arrogant coward, happy to send the soldiers under his command into battle while he hid. He was incompetent and unreasonable, although he was well versed in [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedure and other cultures. He dressed in expensive clothing, and wore a [[poison ring]].<ref name="Godking-CC" />
